problem: Relationship types must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. A camelCase type in a production graph is a correctness hazard: one typo in a query and it silently matches nothing.
PascalCase property on a node whose other properties are snake_case. Inconsistent casing breaks tooling and will cause null reads.
MERGE uses both email and plan, so when a plan changes a second Subscriber node is created for the same email.
fix: MERGE on email only and SET s.plan = row.plan.
